technology_name: A COMPLIANT ROBOTIC END-EFFECTOR WITH FORCE MULTIPLICATION MECHANISM FOR EFFICIENT OBJECT MANIPULATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Rigid mechanical grippers require heavy motor actuators to achieve high gripping forces, which increases payload mass and often crushes delicate handling objects.
description: An advanced compliant robotic end-effector structure engineered with a series of flexible links attached to a central base housing to combine double rocker inversion kinematics with built-in force magnification channels.
applications: Automated pick-and-place manufacturing cells, fragile consumer goods sorting loops, hazardous material handling systems, and adaptive robotic arm tools.
